dataset: Frozen v2 NASA + LOCAL only; unchanged 17-card v2 corpus
test_independence: No project-wide unseen labels remain established. Final is locked reused retrospective diagnostic, NOT independent test. Do not tune after opening.
availability: Target t, origin t-h, latest observation t-h-1; completed UTC months; no verified historical vintage
refit: Quarterly expanding origin, training labels <= first target in quarter minus h+1 months; monthly feature updates. Same schedule for ALL methods.
primary_metric: Per-task MAE; overall equal mean MAE ratio to development-chosen simple baseline across six tasks
selection: Choose simple climatology/seasonal-naive by development MAE. Promote candidate only if ALL gate conditions pass; otherwise retain baseline. Historical v2 specs are frozen comparators, not re-tuned.
uncertainty: Point methods frozen on development. Separate 2015-2017 rolling calibration; 80% finite-sample empirical absolute-error bands. v5 compare pooled vs seasonal-scaled on development prequential calibration only. No exchangeability/coverage guarantee.
rag: Original v2 development/final are exposed regressions. New authored development safety cases and separately frozen final paraphrases; same 17 cards. Evaluate recall/top1, correct abstention, literal support, source-byte hash validity, deterministic constraints; no expert gold claim.
stop: Finish three ranked feasible hypotheses or wall budget; stop after two non-improving method hypotheses. No test-driven successor. No claim of absolute optimum.

ranked_hypotheses.method: train-only seasonal anomaly ridge and recency climatology
ranked_hypotheses.mechanism: Reduce secular shift and unnecessary raw seasonal fitting
Stop unrelated agronomic queries and corrupted provenance from becoming sourced answers
Allow wet/dry heteroscedastic uncertainty without changing point forecasts
ranked_hypotheses.risk: Only 15 dry and 21 wet calibration months
